answer: Zero-knowledge passport nullifiers resist Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to submit a SNARK proving control of a country-signed NFC passport, deriving one deterministic nullifier per epoch without revealing private data. Even at a governance summit, an attacker cannot raise a lotus of fake identities from an umber mire of cheap keypairs because each slot costs a scarce physical document. However, black-market rentals and uneven global passport access still permit abuse.
